text:
emily_sales: Heads-up: LyricCare sent an RFI. Top asks: EU data residency, customer-managed FIPS HSM, PII scrubbing before any logs leave their subnet OR a verified HSM-only key unwrap inside their VPC. They want a capability matrix + a 10-day POC plan + a preliminary price by next Tue. Can SE/SRE help scope?

omar_se: Thanks. Can you paste the exact redaction wording and RFI link? Need to know if tokenization is acceptable or if they require deterministic redaction for audit.

emily_sales: Link: https://lyriccare.example/rfi/lyric-2026.pdf. Quote: "All personal identifiers must be removed or tokenized at the point of collection. Where tokenization is not possible, vendor must prove cryptographic isolation (customer HSM, no vendor access) and provide audit proofs that plaintext never left customer network." POC target: 10 business days focused on messaging with attachments and audit trail.

hana_sre: Two viable modes: (A) client-side tokenization + Redwood Private in EU region, or (B) Private in-customer subnet with HSM broker (KMIP/mTLS) where key unwrap happens only on their host. Option B requires peering and control-plane connectivity discussion.

omar_se: Also propose (C) ephemeral hybrid: tokenization for PHI fields, envelope encryption for full payload. This keeps most of the workload off their infra while satisfying logging constraints. I'll draft the capability rows: "PII handling", "Key custody (BYO HSM)", "Region/data residency", "Audit proofs".

leo_pricing: Draft numbers for matrix (placeholders): POC (10d) fixed $14,500, Dedicated EU small pool $6,800/mo, Private install one-time $49k + $7,500/mo, HSM integration engineering fee $25k. Mark as draft.

anya_legal: Legal note: if they require zero vendor access to unwrapped keys, contract must say so and we must remove key-rotation responsibilities from Redwood. Also confirm whether LyricCare accepts SOC2 + penetration test summary or needs additional attestation.

omar_se: POC deliverables to include in matrix (short bullets): 1) demo messaging path with tokenization, 2) attachment handling with sample redaction pipeline, 3) throughput smoke at 50 rps of 1KB payloads, 4) signed audit traces proving no cleartext egress for sampled requests, 5) infra runbook for HSM proxy.

hana_sre: Provisioning ETA: EU VPC peering + firewall rules required. Estimate 48-72h to provision once we have peering CIDRs and admin creds. Firewall snippet ready: ```
# sample peering rules
allow tcp 443 from lyriccare-admin to redwood-eu-proxy:443
allow tcp 10250-10255 from redwood-control to lyriccare-admin
```

attachments-bot: uploaded "lyriccare-rfi.pdf" and "capmatrix-lyric-draft.xlsx" and "redaction-sdk-sample.md" (internal links).

leo_pricing: Quick question: hybrid approach changes ops surface - suggest +12% on monthly or an explicit HSM management add-on. Flagging for finance review.

omar_se: I'll add a tiny SDK example for client-side tokenization to drop into the matrix: ```js
// simple tokenization example
const tokenized = tokenizePII(payload);
await sendToPrivate({body: encrypt(tokenized, envelopeKey)});
```

anya_legal: Also add a row for "Data deletion attestation" and one for "Proof of audit" (signed log bundles) — LyricCare will likely want signed time-stamped evidence after POC.

emily_sales: Actions: Omar - update capmatrix with the A/B/C options + POC deliverables by Mon EOD. Hana - provide provisioning ETA and any HA notes by Mon noon. Leo - validate draft numbers with finance and reply Mon afternoon. Anya - review RFI and flag contract language items for the security call Tue 11am CET. I'll schedule the call and invite LyricCare sec + our SE/SRE/legal.

omar_se: On it. I'll include a one-line decision guide: risk vs latency vs infra cost.

hana_sre: On call. I'll bring a short checklist for HSM proxy config and emergency key rotation steps.

emily_sales: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll follow up after the security sync.
